title: grothlab/crepas pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

sample.errorMessage: The sample identifier cannot contain spaces. It must be the same for all biological and technical replicates of the same sample.

biological_replicate.errorMessage: The biological replicate must be provided and cannot contain spaces. If you do not have biological replicates you can set the `biological_replicate` to any number or string for each of your samples.

input_control.errorMessage: The input control column cannot contain spaces

exp_type.errorMessage: Sequencing experiment type must be provided and be one of: 'ChIP-seq', 'ChOR-seq', 'SCAR-seq', 'ChIP-exo', 'ATAC-seq', 'OK-seq', 'CUTandRUN', 'CUTandTag', 'TIP-seq'

with_umi.errorMessage: `with_umi` must be set to true for samples that contain UMIs, either in the read sequence, in the read name, or in a separate FastQ file (`fastq_umi`). If your samples contain UMIs, but they are not in a separate FastQ file, set `with_umi` to true and leave the `fastq_umi` column empty.

extract_umi.errorMessage: If the UMIs are contained in the read sequence, `extract_umi` must be set to true to move them to the read name. If the UMIs have already been extracted and moved to the read name, set `extract_umi` to false.

fastq_1.errorMessage: GZIP-compressed FastQ file for reads 1 must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

fastq_2.errorMessage: GZIP-compressed FastQ file for reads 2 cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

fastq_umi.errorMessage: GZIP-compressed FastQ file for UMI reads cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'
